activated.descr: whether the paired Guild has left draft; settings are re-validated on policy changes afterwards

activeBallots.descr: number of proposals with an open ballot

guild.descr: Guild permanently paired with this consensus application

maximumWeight.descr: largest current offering weight; bounds the proposer power a Guild may require

minimumApprovals.descr: minimum absolute approval weight required for a proposal to pass

offeringCount.descr: number of services currently granting voting weight

offeringEpoch.descr: monotonic counter incremented by every offering change

subscriptions.descr: subscriptions application hosting this policy's services

contract.name: SubscriptionGuildConsensus
contract.desc:
One subscription vote weighted by the offering it pays for.

Every offering is a subscription service this application creates and owns, so no outside
service owner can pause, gate, or block the Guild's electorate. Services are ALGO-priced, ungated,
and pay out to the Guild application. Offerings and the absolute approval floor are administered
through opaque Guild consensus actions (`uint8 code || payload`, see ./constants.ts), and at least
one offering always remains open for subscription.

Offering weights are versioned by epoch and every ballot freezes the epoch it opened at, so
offering changes never alter the weight of a ballot that is already open.

A subscription votes only on ballots that opened after it had been paid, without a gap, for one
full payment interval (readiness audit 2026-11-09, C13). Dues are paid into the Guild's own
treasury, so without this a proposal that pays out of the treasury could be carried by accounts
that subscribed for the occasion and took their dues back out with it. With it, new voting
weight is visible to the existing members for a whole interval before it can be used, and it
cannot vote on anything they open in that time. Proposing is not seasoned, only voting.

methods.name: subscriberPowerAt
methods.desc:
Voting weight a subscription grants on an open ballot; `evidence` matches `vote`.
Zero when the subscription is not paid up now, or was not yet seasoned when the ballot opened.

methods.name: proposalPower
methods.desc: Proposers need a subscription paid up now, weighted by the current offering. Proposing is not seasoned.

methods.name: configurationMbr
methods.desc: Service creation funding plus offering storage for each new service; unused funding is refunded.

methods.name: configure
methods.desc: Create the initial owned services through the paired Guild while it is in draft.

methods.name: consensusActionMbr
methods.desc: Quote and validate an opaque consensus action; unsupported codes are rejected.

methods.name: applyConsensusAction
methods.desc:
Apply an approved Guild consensus action; direct accounts cannot call this route.

A new approval floor may not exceed the approvals of the proposal that sets it, so the Guild
can never raise its floor beyond what its own voters just demonstrated.

methods.name: bindGuild
methods.desc: Permanently bind this consensus instance to the Guild created beside it.

methods.name: chatStewardMbr
methods.desc:
Storage a chat steward action needs: the first steward of a chat pays for its box, while a
change of steward or a revocation needs nothing.

methods.name: applyChatSteward
methods.desc:
Set the steward of one chat, or revoke it with the zero address. Only the paired Guild can call
this, and it does so only while executing an approved proposal. A revocation hands the box's
storage back to the Guild.

methods.name: assertChatStewardAuthority
methods.desc:
Guard for a steward's own transactions: fails unless `steward` is the governed steward of `chat`
and the Guild's program is sealed. Placed in the same group as the steward's call, it proves in
that group that the Guild program checked off chain is still the one running.

methods.name: getChatSteward
methods.desc: The governed steward of a chat, or the zero address when it has none.

methods.name: hasVoted
methods.desc: Whether `voter` has a vote on the proposal (a further vote changes it).
